    Rebenko Georgy

    Hard Surface 3D Artist
    Gyumri, Armenia

    Professional Profile

    3D Artist with 5 years of experience, specializing in hard surface modeling — weapons, armor, machinery, vehicles, industrial props, environments. I work full-cycle: from concept and blockout to final engine integration.

    I am proficient in all pipeline stages: high-poly sculpting / SubD modeling, retopology, UV unwrapping, baking, PBR texturing, LOD preparation, and lightmap UVs for game engines.

    Participated in international game jams (Ludum Dare) as a 3D Artist and Team Lead — experience in team building, task distribution, and remote workflow coordination.

    Professional Experience

    ANO PO “IT HUB” — Moscow, Russia
    3D Artist
    2019 – present

    Hard Surface assets:

    • Weapons & gear: stylized grappling hook (Sci-Fi/Steampunk), accelerator coils, tactical carabiner — full cycle from blockout to high-poly.
    • Historical armor: medieval armor (ZBrush + Blender) — articulation, joints, surface wear.
    • Throwing weapon set: three rarity tiers of chakrams — shared UV set, PBR textures in Substance Painter, engine optimization.
    • Modular environment: tile set for an isometric game — lava channels, obsidian platforms, destructible constructs.
    • Environment props: fantasy lanterns, ruined stone pedestal, vintage arcade machine.

    Texturing & materials:

    • Procedural PBR materials in Substance Designer: scrap metal, stylized ceramic tile, rocks, dirt, forest floor.
    • Environment tiles with full map sets (Base Color, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, AO, Height).

    Game jams (Ludum Dare):

    • Team Lead & 3D Artist — team building, Kanban board management, coordination via Syncthing and Obsidian.
    • Asset creation under tight time constraints (72 hours).
    • Integration of finished models into the game loop.
